accessibility.evidence: Native labelled account inputs, buttons, journal tabs and follow controls. Tab focus visible under reduced motion in browser smoke; no page errors.

responsive.evidence: Account, community, journeys and profile tested at 360/390/1440 with no horizontal overflow.

loading.evidence: Async account feed and journey fetches have visible loading states; browser waits for actual persisted records.

empty.evidence: New private account begins with no feed posts, requests or journeys; composer and journey recorder offer next actions.

error.evidence: Unit tests reject incorrect passwords, expired/reused recovery codes, malformed photos, body limits and cross-origin mutations. Browser confirms CSRF 403 and future journey date rejection.

partial.evidence: Local bookmarks stay on device until explicit account backup; private profiles expose discoverable names but not posts. Unconfirmed artisan milestone remains unavailable.

success.evidence: Two-account browser smoke confirms signup, follow approval, private-photo access, persisted comments/likes, collection backups and earned/featured journey milestones.

permission.evidence: Guest and non-follower photo requests return 404. Approval grants access; follower removal revokes access immediately. Private featured badges are withheld from non-followers.

renderedEvidence.observation: Account/community/journey/profile UI captured in isolated test accounts at the target viewport; account credentials and recovery codes excluded.
